served.architecture: LoRA rank 8 (alpha 16) on attention projections + trained scalar decision head
served.readout: independent_candidate_lora_nll_brier: one forward pass per candidate, scalar head on the last hidden state, softmax over candidates / T

serving.engine: PyTorch/transformers via each project's own loader. Neither vLLM nor SGLang can serve Open-Jev: its decision comes from a trained scalar head on the backbone's hidden state, not from token logits.
serving.prefix_cache_reason: Open-Jev's opt-in request-local prefix cache failed a numeric A/B against the full-prefill path (worst probability delta 0.0311) and was 2.6x slower on this workload; rejected.
serving.sharding: corpus stride shards rows[i::4], one single-GPU replica per shard (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; no tensor parallelism)
serving.transport: POST /v1/systemone on 127.0.0.1, ssh -L tunnel from the dev host; no port exposed publicly
